name: burrow-go-debug
description: Minimal Go debugging for Burrow via `dlv dap` (Delve). Bridges the workbench debug UI to a host-installed Delve DAP server. IX prerequisite (WO-2); the full engine is architecture task 04.

program.description: Package folder or built binary to debug.

mode.description: 'debug' builds and runs the package, 'test' builds and runs its tests, 'exec' runs a prebuilt binary.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the debugged program.

env.description: Environment variables for the debugged program.

cwd.description: Working directory for the debugged program.

buildFlags.description: Flags passed to the Go compiler (e.g. -race, -tags).

stopOnEntry.description: Pause at program entry instead of running to the first breakpoint.

showLog.description: Show Delve's own logging in the debug console.

mode.description: 'local' attaches to a process by pid, 'remote' connects to a headless dlv.

processId.description: Process id to attach to (local mode).

host.description: Host of a remote headless dlv (remote mode).

port.description: Port of a remote headless dlv (remote mode).

configurationSnippets.label: Go: Launch package
configurationSnippets.description: Build and debug the Go package in the workspace folder.

configurationSnippets.label: Go: Attach to process
configurationSnippets.description: Attach Delve to a running Go process.
